title: S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry
title_zh: Segment Anything 模型 S4VY 发布

paragraphs.en: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box-conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.

paragraphs.en: Instance-level segmentation of dynamic scenes is fundamental to perception and planning in embodied systems such as humanoid robots and autonomous vehicles. The SAM family ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ; Carion et al., 2026 ) supports promptable segmentation across images and videos. Yet these models remain centered on predicting sets of 2D masks and propagating temporal memory to track instances among frames, without explicitly modeling the spatial geometry shared across observations. This becomes a critical bottleneck in challenging dynamic scenes, where multiple visually similar objects move simultaneously and must be re-identified after extended occlusion or absence from view. Real-world observations may also be sparse or unordered, further challenging sequential identity propagation. These settings call for object identities established through shared 3D/4D geometry, rather than inherited solely along an ordered sequence of 2D frames.
paragraphs.zh: 动态场景的实例级分割是人形机器人和自动驾驶汽车等具身系统感知与规划的基础。 SAM 系列（Kirillov et al., 2023；Ravi et al., 2025；Carion et al., 2026）支持跨图像和视频的可提示分割。 然而这些模型仍然以预测二维掩码集合以及在帧间传播时序记忆来跟踪实例为核心，而没有显式建模各观测之间共享的空间几何。 这在具有挑战性的动态场景中成为关键瓶颈：多个视觉上相似的物体同时运动，并且必须在长时间遮挡或离开视野后重新被识别。 现实世界的观测还可能是稀疏或无序的，这进一步挑战了基于顺序的身份传播。 这些场景要求通过共享的三维/四维几何来建立物体身份，而不是仅仅沿有序的二维帧序列来继承身份。

paragraphs.en: Segmentation on explicit 3D representations offers a direct route to spatial scene understanding ( Jiang et al., 2020 ; Schult et al., 2023 ; Kolodiazhnyi et al., 2024 ; Choy et al., 2026 ) , but typically assumes the inputs to be point clouds or RGB-D observations obtained from separate reconstruction pipelines or specialized sensors. This dependence potentially accumulates errors and limits data scalability. Recent feed-forward visual geometry models ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026a ) recover scene geometry directly from RGB observations in a single forward pass. Their consistent geometry representations have enabled methods that couple feed-forward reconstruction with semantic, panoptic, or instance segmentation ( Zust et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . Within this visual-geometry paradigm, most of them target static scenes. IGGT4D ( Zou et al., 2026 ) extends instance segmentation to dynamic 4D scenes, but associates local masks with an additional feature clustering, while flexible prompt interfaces remain underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 在显式3D表示上进行分割为空间场景理解提供了一条直接路径（Jiang et al., 2020；Schult et al., 2023；Kolodiazhnyi et al., 2024；Choy et al., 2026），但其通常假设输入是由独立重建流程或专用传感器获得的点云或RGB-D观测。 这种依赖性可能会累积误差并限制数据可扩展性。 近期的前馈式视觉几何模型（Wang et al., 2024a；Wang et al., 2025a；Wang et al., 2026c；Wang et al., 2026a）能够在单次前向传播中直接从RGB观测恢复场景几何。 它们一致的几何表示催生了一些将前馈重建与语义分割、全景分割或实例分割相耦合的方法（Zust et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025a；Qu et al., 2026；Zou et al., 2026）。 在这一视觉几何范式下，其中大多数方法针对的是静态场景。 IGGT4D（Zou et al., 2026）将实例分割扩展到动态4D场景，但其通过额外的特征聚类来关联局部掩码，而灵活的提示接口仍未得到充分探索。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we present S4VY (pronounced “savvy”), named for its goal of segmenting anything in 4D visual geometry. As shown in Fig. 1 , S4VY is a Segment Anything model that unifies prompt-free, exhaustive 4D instance segmentation with prompt-conditioned selection of any discovered instance in a shared 4D visual-geometric representation. Our segmentation model operates on geometry features jointly contextualized across all input observations by a feed-forward visual geometry backbone ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , regardless of their order. A Space-Time Query Decoder uses global learnable object queries to predict instance masks, with each active query maintaining one instance identity across the entire observation set. A Prompt Encoder maps point or box prompts from one or multiple observations to a promptable object query,enabling any object in the observed scene to be selected.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出S4VY（发音为“savvy”），其名称源于它在4D视觉几何中对任意物体进行分割的目标。 如图1所示，S4VY是一个Segment Anything模型，它将无提示的穷举式4D实例分割与基于提示条件选择任意已发现实例统一在共享的4D视觉几何表示中。 我们的分割模型在由前馈视觉几何主干网络（Wang et al., 2026a）在所有输入观测之间联合上下文化得到的几何特征上运行，无论这些观测的顺序如何。 时空查询解码器使用全局可学习物体查询来预测实例掩码，每个活跃查询在整个观测集合中维护一个实例身份。 提示编码器将来自一个或多个观测的点或框提示映射为可提示的物体查询，从而可以选取所观测场景中的任意物体。

paragraphs.en: Beyond point and box prompts, natural-language grounding provides an important interface for users and downstream systems to specify target instances in 4D scenes. A referent may appear in only a limited subset of a large observation set, making target discovery and consistent 4D association challenging. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced reasoning segmentation and visual grounding ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Rasheed et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while MVGGT ( Wu et al., 2026a ) extends referring segmentation to sparse multiview RGB inputs. These methods assume static scenes or fixed sparse views, leaving target discovery and consistent grounding over large dynamic observation sets unresolved. We develop an agentic grounding harness specifically designed for feed-forward 4D visual geometry. Its dual-stream Grounder combines the geometry-consistent feature space of the segmentation model with the fine-grained visual priors of the VLM, producing complementary object-query and bounding-box predictions. Guided by the Grounder’s target-presence estimates, Active Tree Search recursively locates relevant observations across the frame space without evaluating every fixed window. A comparative Critic jointly evaluates representative overlays of the two mask candidates and selects the final 4D instance.

paragraphs.en: With the scaling of vision transformers and training data, multi-view geometry has rapidly shifted from optimization pipelines to feed-forward reconstruction. DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) initiated the modern line through pointmap regression, after which stronger correspondence, whole-set aggregation, and greater scale steadily widened its reach ( Leroy et al., 2024 ; Wang and Agapito, 2025 ; Cabon et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) then brought cameras, depth, pointmaps, and tracks into one transformer. Geometry became a shared multi-view feature space. π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026c ) further removes reference-view dependence through permutation-equivariant visual geometry prediction, while VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) extended this shared geometric representation across static and dynamic scenes. These representations have quickly become substrates for scene understanding, with semantic and panoptic prediction increasingly coupled to feed-forward reconstruction ( Fan et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Zust et al., 2025 ) . At the instance level, IGGT ( Li et al., 2025a ) groups geometry-aware features, whereas SegVGGT ( Qu et al., 2026 ) and FAST3DIS ( Li et al., 2026a ) decode object queries; IGGT4D ( Zou et al., 2026 ) is among the few methods to extend joint reconstruction and instance understanding explicitly to 4D. This line differs from methods that segment an existing point cloud or space–time scan ( Choy et al., 2019 ; Jiang et al., 2020 ; Aygun et al., 2021 ; Vu et al., 2022 ; Kreuzberg et al., 2023 ; Schult et al., 2023 ; Kolodiazhnyi et al., 2024 ; Choy et al., 2026 ; Steiner et al., 2026 ) , as well as approaches that lift 2D masks into a preconstructed neural or Gaussian scene ( Siddiqui et al., 2023 ; Bhalgat et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Wu et al., 2026b ) . Within this paradigm, most methods remain limited to static multi-view scenes, while the closest dynamic extension relies on clustering-based identity association. Moreover, existing methods do not unify exhaustive 4D instance discovery with point, box, and language interfaces. S4VY addresses these limitations within a shared feed-forward 4D representation.

paragraphs.en: SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) established promptable image segmentation, while subsequent models extended its interface to text and controllable mask granularity and improved segmentation quality, efficiency, and robustness ( Zou et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Ke et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Video extensions either attach tracking or temporal memory to image masks ( Yang et al., 2023a ; Cheng et al., 2023 ; Rajič et al., 2025 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) , with SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) further supporting text and exemplar concepts, or represent instances with queries shared across a clip ( Cheng et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2022b ) ; both remain defined over 2D image or video representations. SAM-inspired 3D and 4D methods consume explicit point clouds, RGB-D observations, or camera–LiDAR streams ( Cen et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , or lift 2D masks into preconstructed neural or Gaussian scenes ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2024 ) . SAM-V ( Gong et al., 2026 ) integrates feed-forward geometry into SAM but targets prompted multi-view segmentation of static scenes. S4VY instead unifies exhaustive 4D instance discovery with point- and box-conditioned selection over potentially unordered RGB observations.
paragraphs.zh: SAM（Kirillov 等，2023）确立了可提示的图像分割，而后续模型将其接口扩展到文本和可控的掩码粒度，并提升了分割质量、效率和鲁棒性（Zou 等，2023；Li 等，2024a；Ke 等，2023；Xiong 等，2024；Chen 等，2023；Zhang 等，2026b）。 视频扩展方法要么在图像掩码上附加跟踪或时序记忆（Yang 等，2023a；Cheng 等，2023；Rajič 等，2025；Ravi 等，2025），其中 SAM 3（Carion 等，2026）进一步支持文本和示例概念，要么用在片段内共享的查询来表示实例（Cheng 等，2021；Wu 等，2022b）；这两类方法仍然都定义在二维图像或视频表示之上。 受 SAM 启发的 3D 和 4D 方法要么以显式点云、RGB-D 观测或相机–激光雷达数据流作为输入（Cen 等，2023；Yin 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024；Xu 等，2025；Liu 等，2023），要么将二维掩码提升到预先构建的神经场景或高斯场景中（Ye 等，2024；Ji 等，2024）。 SAM-V（Gong 等，2026）将前馈几何整合进 SAM，但针对的是静态场景的、由提示驱动的多视角分割。 S4VY 则将穷举式的 4D 实例发现与基于点和框条件的选择统一到可能无序的 RGB 观测之上。

paragraphs.en: Grounding DINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and language-driven segmentation models such as CRIS ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and Language as Queries ( Wu et al., 2022a ) align free-form text with image regions, masks, and video tracks. Related 3D and 4D work grounds text or open-vocabulary features in scene representations ( Prabhudesai et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Achlioptas et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2023 ; Takmaz et al., 2023 ; Fiebelman et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025d ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . With stronger VLMs, recent work has expanded grounding from direct semantic matching toward free-form descriptions, compositional relations, and implicit intent through reasoning segmentation, geometry-aware 3D localization, and language-guided 4D segmentation ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Rasheed et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Agentic long-video methods iteratively retrieve query-relevant observations or refine visual evidence through hierarchical and active observation ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ) . Most existing scene-grounding methods operate on static scenes or fixed sparse views, while agentic video systems search an ordered timeline for video-level reasoning. S4VY instead grounds persistent instances across large 4D observation sets, incorporating Active Tree Search with VLM visual priors, geometry-consistent features, and Critic selection.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , S4VY builds a query-based 4D segmenter on feed-forward visual geometry, supporting exhaustive 4D instance segmentation as well as point- and box-prompted segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图2所示，S4VY 在前馈视觉几何基础上构建了一个基于查询的4D分割器，支持穷举式4D实例分割以及点和框提示的分割。

paragraphs.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide strong spatial priors for grounding referred objects in individual images, yet their native RGB interface does not exploit the cross-view consistency encoded by feed-forward visual geometry. The backbone register tokens form a compact, language-conditioned scene representation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Supplying all patch tokens from multiple observations would introduce prohibitive context redundancy; we therefore inject the per-frame camera and register tokens as compact geometric context. We further supervise the grounder with a scene-geometry-guided chain of thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) distilled from visual and metric scene cues, including object size, height, and inter-object distance, assisting scene reasoning and query and box predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）为在单张图像中定位所指对象提供了强大的空间先验，但其原生的 RGB 接口并未利用前馈式视觉几何所编码的跨视角一致性。 骨干网络的 register token 构成了一种紧凑的、以语言为条件的场景表示（Wang et al., 2026a）。 提供来自多次观测的全部 patch token 会引入过高的上下文冗余；因此我们将每帧的相机 token 与 register token 作为紧凑的几何上下文注入。 我们进一步用由视觉与度量场景线索（包括对象尺寸、高度以及对象间距离）蒸馏而来的场景几何引导的思维链（CoT）（Wei et al., 2022）对定位器进行监督，以辅助场景推理以及查询与边界框预测。

paragraphs.en: Grounding in a large 4D scene requires locating the observations that contain the referent and associating them with a consistent instance. Processing large observation sets with fixed sliding windows repeatedly evaluates irrelevant content. Agentic video methods mitigate this cost by exploiting temporal continuity to retrieve relevant evidence along an ordered timeline ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . However, our segmenter also accepts sparse or non-consecutive observations, for which temporal prior information is weakened. paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 4 , ATS forms each grounder window by uniformly sampling N w N_{\mathrm{w}} observations from the current search range for joint evaluation. It begins with a global window spanning the full observation set. At each level, the grounder predicts target presence for every sampled observation; the neighboring sample positions around each positive prediction delimit the subranges examined at the next level. Each selected subrange is recursively resampled as a new grounder window, allowing the grounder to determine the next search step from its current predictions. The recursion stops once each grounder window contains only adjacent frames. Predictions from all examined windows are aggregated by voting to form two mask candidates from two streams respectively. Representative observations are then selected, and the candidate masks are rendered as overlays and presented jointly with the expression x x to the critic for comparative evaluation, determining the final mask 𝐌 ^ ∗ \hat{\mathbf{M}}^{*} .
paragraphs.zh: 如图 4 所示，ATS 通过从当前搜索范围内均匀采样 N w N_{\mathrm{w}} 个观测来构成每个智能体窗口，以进行联合评估。 它从一个覆盖完整观测集合的全局窗口开始。 在每一层，智能体会对每个采样观测预测目标是否存在；每个正预测周围的相邻采样位置界定了下一层要检查的子范围。 每个被选中的子范围会被递归地重新采样为新的智能体窗口，使智能体能够根据其当前预测确定下一步搜索。 一旦每个智能体窗口仅包含相邻帧，递归即停止。 所有被检查窗口的预测通过投票聚合，从两个流中分别形成两个掩码候选。 随后选出代表性观测，将候选掩码渲染为叠加层，并与表达 x x 一起呈现给评审者进行对比评估，从而确定最终掩码 𝐌 ^ ∗ \hat{\mathbf{M}}^{*} 。

paragraphs.en: Exhaustive set prediction treats every unmatched query as no-object, which would suppress unlabelled instances if applied directly to partial annotations. We therefore train a teacher on the exhaustive sources and use its temporally consistent masklets to densify partial annotations and supervise unlabelled data. Human annotations take precedence, overlapping teacher predictions are removed, and uncertain regions are ignored. This transfers exhaustive instance coverage to the broader corpus without treating missing annotations as background.
paragraphs.zh: 穷举集合预测将每个未匹配的查询视为无对象（no-object），若直接应用于部分标注，会抑制未标注的实例。 因此，我们在穷举来源上训练一个教师模型，并利用其时间上一致的 masklet 来稠密化部分标注并监督未标注的数据。 人工标注具有优先权，重叠的教师预测会被移除，不确定的区域则被忽略。 这样可以在不将缺失标注视为背景的情况下，把穷举的实例覆盖能力迁移到更广泛的语料库上。

paragraphs.en: For segmentation, we compare lifted 3D segmentation ( Yang et al., 2023b ) , image/video systems ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) , and feed-forward visual-geometry methods ( Zust et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ; Gong et al., 2026 ) . Official checkpoints receive the same observations without semantic labels, target prompts, or first-frame ground truth. SAM 2 uses automatic mask discovery with periodic re-discovery, while memory-intensive baselines retain all observations through full-sequence or streaming inference. Grounding baselines cover VLM–segmenter and 3D-proposal pipelines ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Drozdov et al., 2026 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) , end-to-end image/video referring models ( Carion et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ) , and multi-view geometry–language alignment ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . VLM + + SAM 2 jointly processes eight uniformly sampled video observations and predicts boxes or absence before bidirectional propagation; MVGGT receives the same number of observations. Z3D uses reconstructed geometry except in the explicitly marked GT oracle rows.
paragraphs.zh: 在分割任务上，我们对比了提升式3D分割方法（Yang et al., 2023b）、图像/视频系统（Cheng et al., 2023; Wu et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024b; Ravi et al., 2025），以及前馈式视觉-几何方法（Zust et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025a; Qu et al., 2026; Zou et al., 2026; Gong et al., 2026）。 官方检查点在接收相同观测时，不使用语义标签、目标提示或首帧真值。 SAM 2 使用自动掩码发现与周期性重发现机制，而内存开销大的基线方法则通过全序列或流式推理保留所有观测。 定位基线涵盖 VLM–分割器与3D候选框流水线（Xu et al., 2024; Drozdov et al., 2026; Ravi et al., 2025）、端到端图像/视频指代模型（Carion et al., 2026; Yuan et al., 2026a），以及多视角几何-语言对齐方法（Wu et al., 2026a）。 VLM + + SAM 2 联合处理八个均匀采样的视频观测，并在双向传播之前预测边界框或目标缺失；MVGGT 接收相同数量的观测。 Z3D 使用重建的几何信息，但在明确标注为 GT oracle 的行中除外。

sents.zh: 定位基线涵盖 VLM–分割器与3D候选框流水线（Xu et al., 2024; Drozdov et al., 2026; Ravi et al., 2025）、端到端图像/视频指代模型（Carion et al., 2026; Yuan et al., 2026a），以及多视角几何-语言对齐方法（Wu et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: VLM + + SAM 2 jointly processes eight uniformly sampled video observations and predicts boxes or absence before bidirectional propagation; MVGGT receives the same number of observations.
sents.zh: VLM + + SAM 2 联合处理八个均匀采样的视频观测，并在双向传播之前预测边界框或目标缺失；MVGGT 接收相同数量的观测。

sents.en: Z3D uses reconstructed geometry except in the explicitly marked GT oracle rows.
sents.zh: Z3D 使用重建的几何信息，但在明确标注为 GT oracle 的行中除外。

paragraphs.en: The segmenter initializes from the VGGT- Ω \Omega -1B checkpoint at 512-pixel resolution. We use rank-256 LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) adapters and train the segmenter for 50,000 steps. The Grounder initializes from Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , uses eight-observation windows during training and inference, and is trained on approximately 80k expressions. The Critic initializes from Qwen3-VL-2B and is trained separately on paired mask candidates. Reported prompting results use the separately trained Prompt Encoder. Additional training and baseline settings are given in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 分割器从 VGGT-Ω-1B 检查点初始化，分辨率为 512 像素。 我们使用 rank-256 的 LoRA（Hu et al., 2021）适配器，并将分割器训练 50,000 步。 定位器从 Qwen3-VL-4B（Bai et al., 2025）初始化，在训练和推理时使用八次观测窗口，并在约 8 万条表达式上训练。 评价器从 Qwen3-VL-2B 初始化，并在成对的掩码候选上单独训练。 报告的提示结果使用单独训练的提示编码器。 额外的训练与基线设置见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares prompt-free instance segmentation across static multi-view scenes and dynamic videos. S4VY leads every benchmark: its 0.803 T-mIoU and 0.792 T-SR on ScanNet reflect accurate cross-view instance recovery, while 0.803 and 0.602 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} on DAVIS and LVOS show that persistent identities are maintained in dynamic scenes without temporal memory propagation. The gains in STQ and mAP extend this result to dense panoptic evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 evaluates transfer to egocentric and driving perception. HOI4D and VISOR are zero-shot evaluations, while KITTI-STEP uses a held-out driving split. S4VY leads all reported metrics on the three datasets. T-SR remains lower than the other measures for every method because small, similar targets, rapid motion, occlusion, and re-entry make persistent full-clip recovery harder.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 评估了向第一人称视角感知和驾驶感知的迁移。 HOI4D 和 VISOR 是零样本评估，而 KITTI-STEP 使用了一个留出的驾驶数据划分。 S4VY 在这三个数据集上的所有报告指标中均领先。 对于所有方法而言，T-SR 都低于其他指标，这是因为目标小而相似、运动速度快、遮挡以及再次出现，使得持续的全片段恢复更加困难。

paragraphs.en: The ten-clip ScanNet setting is complemented by the complete 312-scene ScanNet200 validation split in Tab. 5 . S4VY improves over IGGT4D by 2.9, 4.6, and 2.8 points in T-mIoU, T-SR, and 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} , respectively. Table 5 further compares sparse observations with shuffled versions of the same inputs. Video baselines that propagate information along the sequence decline after shuffling, whereas feed-forward geometry methods do not exhibit a consistent decline. On the appearance-diverse, shuffled LVOS setting, S4VY reaches 0.588 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} , 12.6 points above the strongest video baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 十段剪辑的 ScanNet 设置之外，表 5 还补充了完整的 312 个场景的 ScanNet200 验证集。 S4VY 在 T-mIoU、T-SR 和 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} 上分别超过 IGGT4D 2.9、4.6 和 2.8 个点。 表 5 进一步将稀疏观测与相同输入的打乱版本进行了比较。 沿序列传播信息的视频基线在打乱后性能下降，而前馈几何方法并未表现出一致的下降。 在外观多样、打乱后的 LVOS 设置上，S4VY 达到 0.588 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}，比最强的视频基线高 12.6 个点。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 supplies every method with the same sampled prompts. S4VY is strongest with point prompts, whereas SAM 2 is generally stronger with clean multi-observation box prompts. Under corrupted prompts from annotation or upstream localization errors, the Prompt Encoder’s relevance scoring suppresses inconsistent evidence and substantially improves robustness over propagation-based prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 表6为所有方法提供了相同的采样提示。 S4VY在使用点提示时表现最强，而SAM 2在使用干净的多观测框提示时总体更强。 在来自标注或上游定位错误的受损提示下，提示编码器的相关性评分抑制了不一致的证据，并相较基于传播的提示方法大幅提升了鲁棒性。

sents.en: Table 6 supplies every method with the same sampled prompts.
sents.zh: 表6为所有方法提供了相同的采样提示。

sents.en: S4VY is strongest with point prompts, whereas SAM 2 is generally stronger with clean multi-observation box prompts.
sents.zh: S4VY在使用点提示时表现最强，而SAM 2在使用干净的多观测框提示时总体更强。

sents.en: Under corrupted prompts from annotation or upstream localization errors, the Prompt Encoder’s relevance scoring suppresses inconsistent evidence and substantially improves robustness over propagation-based prompting.

paragraphs.en: Table 7 compares S4VY with VLM–segmenter pipelines, end-to-end referring models, and Z3D’s explicit 3D-proposal grounding under the unified protocol. S4VY performs best across the four evaluations. Z3D approaches our static-scene results only with ground-truth point clouds; replacing them with reconstructed point clouds causes a large decline, showing the sensitivity of proposal-first 3D grounding to imperfect geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 表7在统一协议下将S4VY与VLM分割器流水线、端到端指代模型以及Z3D的显式3D提案定位进行了比较。 S4VY在四项评估中均表现最佳。 Z3D仅在使用真值点云时才能接近我们的静态场景结果；将真值点云替换为重建点云会导致性能大幅下降，这表明提案优先的3D定位对不完美的几何信息十分敏感。

sents.en: Table 7 compares S4VY with VLM–segmenter pipelines, end-to-end referring models, and Z3D’s explicit 3D-proposal grounding under the unified protocol.
sents.zh: 表7在统一协议下将S4VY与VLM分割器流水线、端到端指代模型以及Z3D的显式3D提案定位进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 compares grounding tools with the same Prompt Encoder and mask decoder. General-purpose MLLMs and single-image grounding tools provide strong local priors, but their coordinate predictions are not aligned with the persistent instance space. Our query stream uses that representation directly and obtains the strongest result, while the box stream retains the VLM’s native spatial prediction interface.
paragraphs.zh: 表8在相同的Prompt Encoder和掩码解码器下对各种定位工具进行了比较。 通用多模态大语言模型和单图像定位工具提供了强大的局部先验，但它们的坐标预测与持久实例空间并不对齐。 我们的查询流直接使用该表示并取得了最强的结果，而框流则保留了VLM原生的空间预测接口。

sents.en: Table 8 compares grounding tools with the same Prompt Encoder and mask decoder.
sents.zh: 表8在相同的Prompt Encoder和掩码解码器下对各种定位工具进行了比较。

sents.en: General-purpose MLLMs and single-image grounding tools provide strong local priors, but their coordinate predictions are not aligned with the persistent instance space.
sents.zh: 通用多模态大语言模型和单图像定位工具提供了强大的局部先验，但它们的坐标预测与持久实例空间并不对齐。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 (a) shows that register tokens provide the largest gain by exposing compact, scene-wide geometric information to the Grounder. Multi-observation inference further improves over single-view grounding by resolving references from cross-view context, and geometry-guided CoT provides an additional gain. Across all four benchmarks in panels (c–d), the Critic consistently improves over either stream alone, confirming that query matching and box prediction capture complementary evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 (a) 表明，寄存器标记通过向 Grounder 暴露紧凑的、场景级的几何信息，带来了最大的提升。 多观测推理通过利用跨视角上下文来解析指代，进一步超越了单视角定位，而几何引导的 CoT 带来了额外的提升。 在 (c–d) 面板中的全部四个基准上，Critic 始终优于任何单一分支，这证实了查询匹配与框预测捕捉到了互补的证据。

sents.en: Table 10 (a) shows that register tokens provide the largest gain by exposing compact, scene-wide geometric information to the Grounder.
sents.zh: 表 10 (a) 表明，寄存器标记通过向 Grounder 暴露紧凑的、场景级的几何信息，带来了最大的提升。

sents.en: Multi-observation inference further improves over single-view grounding by resolving references from cross-view context, and geometry-guided CoT provides an additional gain.
sents.zh: 多观测推理通过利用跨视角上下文来解析指代，进一步超越了单视角定位，而几何引导的 CoT 带来了额外的提升。

paragraphs.en: Panel (b) relates target presence to search cost. ATS uses substantially fewer Grounder windows on ScanRefer and ScanNet++, where the target appears in fewer than 30% of observations. Its mean window count also remains below sliding-window traversal on both video benchmarks, while preserving or improving the reported stream scores in most settings.
paragraphs.zh: 图 (b) 展示了目标存在与搜索成本之间的关系。 在目标出现在少于 30% 观测中的 ScanRefer 和 ScanNet++ 数据集上，ATS 使用的 Grounder 窗口数量显著更少。 在两个视频基准上，其平均窗口数量也保持在滑动窗口遍历之下，同时在大多数设置中保持或提升了所报告的流式得分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows more complete, identity-consistent masks in static and dynamic scenes. In panel (c), several basketball players have similar appearances and repeatedly occlude one another during rapid motion. The purple player’s identity remains stable through the shot, while the ball is still tracked after possession passes to the red player. Panel (d) shows the same persistence under the rapid motion and deformation of the kangaroo and cat. In contrast, SAM 2 can miss newly visible objects or confuse identities across non-contiguous indoor views, and existing feed-forward geometry baselines remain weaker on dynamic objects.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了静态和动态场景中更完整、身份一致的掩码。 在面板 (c) 中，几名篮球运动员外形相似，并在快速运动中反复互相遮挡。 紫色运动员的身份在投篮过程中保持稳定，而当球权转移给红色运动员后，球仍然被持续跟踪。 面板 (d) 显示了在袋鼠和猫的快速运动与形变下同样的持续性。 相比之下，SAM 2 可能会遗漏新出现的物体，或在非连续的室内视角间混淆身份，而现有的前馈几何基线在动态物体上仍然较弱。

sents.zh: 图 6 展示了静态和动态场景中更完整、身份一致的掩码。

sents.en: In panel (c), several basketball players have similar appearances and repeatedly occlude one another during rapid motion.
sents.zh: 在面板 (c) 中，几名篮球运动员外形相似，并在快速运动中反复互相遮挡。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that the same persistent representation supports robust language grounding, including expressions that require spatial reasoning rather than appearance matching alone.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 表明，同一个持久化表征能够支持稳健的语言接地（language grounding），包括那些需要空间推理而不仅仅是外观匹配的表达式。

paragraphs.en: The panoramic and driving examples in Fig. 8 show coherent mask identities when visualized in reconstructed 4D space. This behavior transfers to unconstrained indoor, outdoor, and driving sequences in Fig. 9 , despite large changes in viewpoint, scale, motion, and scene content. These visualizations assess instance consistency in the reconstructed scene rather than independent geometric accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 中的全景与驾驶示例在重建的 4D 空间中可视化时显示出一致的掩码身份。 如图 9 所示，这种特性可以迁移到无约束的室内、室外和驾驶序列，尽管视角、尺度、运动和场景内容发生了较大变化。 这些可视化评估的是重建场景中的实例一致性，而非独立的几何精度。

sents.en: The panoramic and driving examples in Fig. 8 show coherent mask identities when visualized in reconstructed 4D space.

paragraphs.en: We introduced S4VY, a feed-forward Segment Anything model for 4D scenes. By exploiting a shared visual-geometric representation of an RGB observation set, S4VY exhaustively segments class-agnostic instances with persistent identities and supports point- and box-based selection without temporal ordering or memory propagation. We further developed an agentic language-grounding harness that combines VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features, actively searches large observation spaces, and resolves complementary grounding predictions. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under our unified evaluation. A limitation is that jointly processing multiple high-resolution observations constrains the output mask resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 S4VY，一个面向 4D 场景的前馈式 Segment Anything 模型。 通过利用 RGB 观测集合的共享视觉-几何表示，S4VY 能够全面地分割出具有持久身份的类别无关实例，并支持基于点和基于框的选择，无需时间顺序或记忆传播。 我们进一步开发了一个基于语言的智能体（agentic）落地框架，它将 VLM 视觉先验与几何一致的实例特征相结合，主动搜索大规模观测空间，并整合互补的落地预测结果。 在静态与动态场景上的实验表明，在我们统一的评估协议下，该方法实现了最先进的 4D 实例分割和强大的语言引导落地性能。 一个局限性在于，联合处理多个高分辨率观测限制了输出掩码的分辨率。

paragraphs.en: Grounder data. We combine the human referring annotations of ScanRefer ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , MeViS ( Ding et al., 2023a ) , and Ref-DAVIS ( Khoreva et al., 2018 ) with descriptions generated for ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) and LVOS ( Hong et al., 2023 ) , which do not provide referring text. For ScanNet++, we use ground-truth 3D instances and their semantic labels as class anchors. Qwen3-VL-32B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) receives the most visible RGB observation and up to two spatially separated context observations to generate up to five descriptions per instance. Quality control filters refusals, regenerates descriptions that omit the class anchor, checks hallucinations, contradictions, and neighboring-object errors with a VLM, and removes exact duplicates. For LVOS, we use GPT-5.6 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) to generate referring-expression annotations for its video sequences. Each description is associated with its annotated instance or track and matched to a persistent object query by mask overlap over the available observations. For ScanNet++ and the video sources, we discard training pairs whose predicted masks have 2D mask IoU below 0.4 0.4 with the annotations, preventing incomplete or fragmented predictions from introducing incorrect grounding correspondences. After target filtering and source balancing, the training loader contains 79,856 records from 3,065 scenes or videos: 30,352 from ScanRefer, 31,764 from ScanNet++, 16,888 from MeViS, 435 from LVOS, and 417 from Ref-DAVIS.

paragraphs.en: Geometry-guided CoT supervision is generated for the known referent in a separate stage. For video datasets without 3D/4D ground truth, the visual geometry backbone ( Wang et al., 2026a ) reconstructs depth and camera geometry directly from the RGB observations. Back-projecting the ground-truth masks through this geometry yields an object-centric 4D point track, whose per-observation centroids and extents describe the referent’s location, motion, and spatial relations to nearby instances. Static-scene geometry further provides metric object extent, height above the floor, and metric inter-object distances. Since monocular video reconstruction has neither an absolute scale nor a gravity-aligned frame, its facts instead use target visibility, size-normalized motion, relative object size and distance, and variation in camera distance. Qwen3-VL-235B receives these facts, the referring expression, up to four uniformly sampled RGB observations, and the known target, and produces a short rationale that must combine an appearance cue with at least one geometric or spatiotemporal cue without revealing the target index.
paragraphs.zh: 几何引导的思维链监督是在一个单独的阶段中为已知指称对象生成的。 对于没有 3D/4D 真值的视频数据集，视觉几何主干（Wang et al., 2026a）直接从 RGB 观测中重建深度和相机几何。 通过该几何将真值掩码反投影，得到以对象为中心的 4D 点轨迹，其每次观测的质心和范围描述了指称对象的位置、运动以及与邻近实例的空间关系。 静态场景几何进一步提供了度量级的对象尺寸、离地高度以及对象间的度量距离。 由于单目视频重建既没有绝对尺度也没有重力对齐的坐标系，其事实改用目标可见性、尺寸归一化的运动、相对对象大小与距离以及相机距离的变化。 Qwen3-VL-235B 接收这些事实、指称表达、最多四帧均匀采样的 RGB 观测以及已知目标，并生成一段简短的理由说明，该说明必须将外观线索与至少一个几何或时空线索相结合，同时不得泄露目标索引。

paragraphs.en: Critic data. We construct critic training data from the grounder’s full dual-stream predictions on the training splits. For each expression, the query and box outputs are decoded into two candidate masks and rendered as a comparison pair. Candidate quality is measured against the annotated referent using 3D box IoU for static scenes and 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} for videos; the higher-scoring candidate provides the preferred label. We discard pairs in which neither candidate reaches 0.5 0.5 and subsample near-ties, leaving 4,005 comparisons; this prevents jointly failed or ambiguous predictions from introducing noisy comparative supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 评论数据。 我们基于基础模型在训练集划分上的完整双流预测来构建评论训练数据。 对于每个表达式，查询和框输出被解码为两个候选掩码，并渲染为比较对。 候选质量相对于标注的指代对象进行度量：静态场景使用3D框IoU，视频使用𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}；得分较高的候选提供偏好标签。 我们丢弃两个候选均未达到0.5 0.5的配对，并对近平局的结果进行欠采样，最终留下4,005个比较样本；这可以防止共同失败或模糊的预测引入有噪声的比较监督信号。

paragraphs.en: After Hungarian matching, exhaustive set prediction supervises every unmatched query as no-object. Applied directly to partial annotations, this objective would suppress unlabelled instances, while unlabelled sequences provide no positive targets. We therefore train a teacher on the exhaustive sources and use it to densify the remaining data. Original masklets are augmented with non-overlapping teacher predictions for partially annotated samples, whereas unlabelled samples are supervised entirely by the teacher. The shared teacher–student architecture thus transfers exhaustive supervision to the broader corpus through self-distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 在匈牙利匹配之后，穷举集合预测会将每个未匹配的查询监督为无物体。 若直接应用于部分标注数据，该目标函数会抑制未标注的实例，而未标注序列则无法提供任何正样本目标。 因此，我们在穷举标注的数据源上训练一个教师模型，并用它来稠密化其余数据。 对于部分标注的样本，用互不重叠的教师模型预测来增广原始的掩码片段；而对于未标注样本，则完全由教师模型进行监督。 共享的教师–学生架构由此通过自蒸馏将穷举监督迁移到更大规模的语料上。

paragraphs.en: Prompts are sampled online from annotated or pseudo-labelled masklets, with at most four target instances per sample. We use box prompts with probability 0.4 0.4 and point prompts otherwise. A point prompt contains a positive point inside the target mask; for each point-prompted observation, an additional corrective point is sampled outside it with probability 0.3 0.3 . Box prompts are not paired with negative boxes; their coordinates are instead jittered to model localization error. Prompts span a random number of target-visible observations. paragraphs.en: We compare lifted 3D segmentation, video segmentation, and feed-forward visual-geometry methods, using their official checkpoints on the same observations without semantic labels, target prompts, or first-frame ground truth. For SAM 2, the Automatic Mask Generator uses a 16 × 16 16\times 16 point grid to discover instances, whose masks initialize the video predictor. The predictor propagates their identities, while periodic automatic mask generation adds masks with less than 0.5 0.5 IoU to every active track as new instances. Re-discovery is performed every 2 observations for the short ScanNet clips and every 15 15 frames for the video benchmarks. When full-sequence inference exceeds GPU memory, we retain all observations through memory-bounded streaming-window inference. In particular, our IGGT implementation appends fixed scene-wide anchor views to each sliding window, concatenates the resulting dense instance features, and applies clustering over the complete sequence to maintain identities across windows. IGGT4D uses its released offline full-attention configuration. SAM-V uses the released checkpoint and automatic-mask settings; sequences longer than 32 32 observations are processed in overlapping 32 32 -observation windows, with identities matched by mask IoU on the shared observation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了提升式3D分割、视频分割以及前馈视觉几何方法，在相同的观测上使用它们的官方检查点，且不提供语义标签、目标提示或首帧真值。 对于SAM 2，自动掩码生成器使用 16 × 16 16\times 16 的点网格来发现实例，其掩码用于初始化视频预测器。 预测器传播这些实例的身份，同时周期性的自动掩码生成会为每个活跃轨迹添加 IoU 低于 0.5 0.5 的掩码作为新实例。 对于较短的 ScanNet 片段，每 2 个观测执行一次重新发现；对于视频基准，每 15 15 帧执行一次。 当全序列推理超出GPU显存时，我们通过受显存限制的流式滑动窗口推理保留所有观测。 特别地，我们的 IGGT 实现向每个滑动窗口追加固定的场景级锚点视角，拼接所得的稠密实例特征，并在完整序列上应用聚类以跨窗口维持身份。 IGGT4D 使用其发布的离线全注意力配置。 SAM-V 使用发布的检查点和自动掩码设置；超过 32 32 个观测的序列在重叠的 32 32 观测窗口中处理，并通过对共享观测上的掩码 IoU 匹配身份。

paragraphs.en: VLM-Grounder uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking with YOLO-World and a single-view ensemble; for videos, it runs its 3D pipeline on the reconstructed geometry and reprojects the selected box to each observation. VLM + + SAM 2 uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, and Sa2VA uses its released 8B model. SAM 3 and MVGGT use their official end-to-end checkpoints without a separately served VLM: SAM 3 receives category prompts on static scenes and full expressions on videos, while MVGGT receives eight uniformly sampled observations. Z3D ( Drozdov et al., 2026 ) uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking within a 3D-proposal pipeline combining MaskClustering, CLIP retrieval, VLM filtering, SAM 3 segmentation, and 3D proposal voting. To preserve the RGB-only input setting, its proposals are constructed from the feed-forward geometry reconstructed for each scene rather than from ground-truth point clouds; on videos, the selected 3D proposal is projected back to the observations for evaluation. For static scenes, VLM + + SAM 2 ranks the observations with CLIP and predicts a normalized box on the selected view. For the video results in Tab. 7 , the VLM instead receives eight uniformly sampled observations jointly and predicts one box or absence per observation; these boxes initialize SAM 2 for bidirectional propagation over the complete sequence.

paragraphs.en: For class-agnostic segmentation, we use the ScanNet setting from IGGT ( Li et al., 2025a ) , DAVIS 2017, LVOS, and VIPSeg, comprising ten static multi-view clips, 30 30 short videos, 50 50 long-term videos, and 343 343 panoptic videos, respectively. Following ( Li et al., 2025a ; Zou et al., 2026 ) , each ScanNet clip contains 8 sampled observations, while each LVOS video is uniformly sampled to 100 100 observations. For the separate robustness evaluation, each video produces three sparse subsets by sampling 16 16 observations without replacement from its first 32 32 observations, last 32 32 observations, and full temporal extent, respectively; the sampled observations retain their chronological order, and each subset contains annotated foreground. The shuffle setting randomly permutes exactly the same observations and their annotations. For the LVOS hard setting, farthest-point sampling over normalized RGB thumbnail descriptors selects 16 16 appearance-diverse observations across the full video; at least four contain annotated foreground when available, after which their order is shuffled. Additional evaluations further cover two zero-shot egocentric benchmarks: 48 48 HOI4D ( Liu et al., 2022 ) clips and 42 42 EPIC-KITCHENS VISOR ( Darkhalil et al., 2022 ) clips, as well as 9 KITTI-STEP ( Weber et al., 2021 ) sequences for driving scenes. For language grounding, we sample 700 700 ScanRefer queries from 121 121 validation scenes and hold out 80 80 ScanNet++ scenes with 3,320 3{,}320 expressions. The video evaluation contains all 122 122 Ref-DAVIS expressions and 616 616 single-referent MeViS expressions from 47 47 videos.

Because the video benchmarks provide only per-frame 2D masks, both annotated and predicted masks are lifted with the same depth and cameras predicted by the visual geometry backbone ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . The resulting point sets are evaluated with the strict 4D metrics in Eq. 8 , using a separate temporal voxel slice for every observation and one-to-one instance matching.
